name: standart-npc
author: MondoTruth, Lil Art, IceGlaive, Nokzin, Claude, and the Ragnarok Offline community
description: ⚠ Some NPCs may need the Cash Shop for full functionality. Core (always on): Warper, Job Master, Reset Girl, Episode Valkyrie and Stylist -- Prontera. Everything below is optional.

settings.label: Buffer
settings.description: Free instant heal + buffs on click. Every major town.

settings.label: Card Exchanger
settings.description: Trade cards for an album, or pull one out of your gear. Prontera (151,187).

settings.label: Kafra Employee
settings.description: Save point, storage, free identify. Prontera (160,187).

settings.label: Smuggler
settings.description: Buy any item by ID. Prontera (144,174).

settings.label: Gramps
settings.description: Hunting bounties, 7 level brackets from 70 to 231+. Prontera (147,172).

settings.label: Lucky John
settings.description: Area purge bounties, 9 level brackets from 30 to 231+. Prontera (138,172).

settings.label: Cheffenia MVP Dungeon
settings.description: Timed MVP dungeon access, paid in Zeny or Cash Points. Prontera (140,180).

settings.label: Overlook Fisherman
settings.description: 4-floor dungeon ending in a card reward. Prontera (147,169).

settings.label: Safe Refiner
settings.description: Refines gear to +7 through +15 using certificates. Prontera (164,172).

settings.label: Costume Stone Enchanter
settings.description: Attaches an Enchant/Class Stone to a costume slot, for free. Prontera (164,169).

settings.label: Master Nokzin
settings.description: Endows your weapon with an element for an hour, removable for free. Prontera (167,178).

settings.label: Weight Maxxer
settings.description: Trades a Gym Pass for +1 permanent carry capacity, up to 10 times. Prontera (164,166).

settings.label: Training Dummies
settings.description: Stationary target dummies for testing damage output. Prontera (153-158,163).
